note: c7: 神明崎 (五十鈴神社, 猪狩神社, 浮見堂), the コの字岸壁 quay of 魚町, and 港町 below the 気仙沼プラザホテル down to JFみやぎ; east of x 600 is open water. Read from Google Earth 3D (imagery 2026-03-11) in raw/ref/earth/c7 (the whole cell in full_before/, sub-cells sub-n and sub-s with top, four 60-degree and two low obliques each), checked against the GSI photo (raw/ref/earth/c7/gsi_*.jpg) and OSM. Roof colours are the Earth 2026-03-11 top-view readings as they are (no gain; r2 removed an earlier neutral gain of 1.17 that lifted them above the Earth look; the app renders a flat roof about 4 L* lighter than its layout colour, which the layout colour does not compensate). The お魚いちば hall (/25068/138, /139) is left as it was: it belongs to the fish-market survey area.

earth-streets3: c7_24 top + sub-s top, rectified into the r12736 frame (s from (407.1,187.8), o across, + = west): a white-bordered chevron hatch (導流帯) with red-brown paving fills o = -8.1..-2.0 (two solid white borders 6.1 m apart, the east one is the carriageway edge line) from s 13 to s 48.5 (about (418,197) to (435,227)), 10 chevrons at about a 3.7 m pitch, apexes pointing south; west of it the through lanes with one solid white line at o = +4, east of it about 1 m of asphalt, a pale footway (o -9.3..-12.7) and the 90-degree quay stalls. The reserve is split in three along its length (A: north 4 m beside the junction, then the west half W = r12736 and the east half E = the hatch road), because hatchedMedian cannot put a median at a carriageway edge (lanes must be 1 to 4 on each side). [part 1 of 3: A, 4 m, same width as r12736, so the junction node at (407.1,187.8) keeps its three roads]
